subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & technical deep dive scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner discovery recap + next steps (technical deep dive)

Hi Emma / Raj 

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps: 

- Needs & priority: CloudBridge is evaluating a marketplace integration to support low-latency inference for managed customers; primary focus is predictable throughput and SOC2-compatible access controls.
- Key stakeholders: Raj (CTO) for architecture + security, Emma for partner program ops.
- Action items we proposed on the call:
  1) Technical deep dive with Redwood infra engineers to walk integration points (auth, routing, caching).
  2) Share mutual action plan and a short product one-pager.
  3) Confirm timeline for a pilot (target: Q3).

I've attached a mutual action plan (stub) and our product one-pager for context. Can we lock in a 60-minute technical deep dive next week with Raj + your engineers? Below are slot options from our team (all PST):

- Tue 05/11 10:00
11:00
- Tue 05/11 15:00
16:00
- Wed 05/12 09:00
10:00

If none of those work, send a couple alternatives and we'll try to match. Rafael (cc) will bring our lead infra engineer and camila_reyes will be on the invite for partner ops.

Next to the calendar invite I'll create a short mutual action plan in Drive and link it here.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
